race.title: Karina's 60th Birthday Celebration Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: CHAMBERS is well treated on his Flat form and having won his latest start in that sphere, he's fancied to make a successful handicap hurdle debut. Arcon didn't immediately improve on his handicap bow but looks capable of making an impact in this sort of company, whilst Prince Phil can improve handicapping. CHAMBERS (IRE) ARCON (GER) PRINCE PHIL
race.bettingForecast: Chambers (5/2), Savanna Storm (6/1), Josh Central (7/1), Stone Cold (8/1), Pink 'n Purple (10/1), Arcon (10/1), Both Of Us (12/1), Prince Phil (12/1), Moi Mon Vieux (14/1), Lady Blackmore (16/1), Bargain Hunter (16/1), Famous Shoes (16/1)
